summary: Heavy foreign buying and softer crude give Indian stocks support into Monday, set against nerves over global tech and inflation running above the RBI's comfort zone.

detail.leaders: Large caps favoured by foreign buyers; oil-sensitive sectors as crude eases
detail.laggards: IT and AI-linked names while Nvidia's turmoil weighs on tech; rate-sensitives after the inflation print
detail.tone: A look-ahead to Monday 16 November. Friday's flow data, out since the afternoon note, show foreign investors kept buying heavily even as stocks fell, and crude ended a second losing week.
watch: Whether foreign buying continues at last week's pace
Nvidia's results on 17 November, out before India opens on Wednesday
Whether crude holds its slide on surplus worries
